entries.disposition: After the raw report has the exact source count and every entry has passed unique known-source mapping, mapped.size must equal sources.files.length; this defensive completeness failure cannot execute.
Every evidence destination is a nonempty basename or fixed nonempty bundle filename inside outputDir, so relative(outputDir, path) cannot be empty and the basename fallback cannot execute.
strictArtifactRef admits basename-only refs, therefore resolve(artifactRoot, ref) is lexically inside artifactRoot and this defensive escape rejection cannot execute.

readRegular rejects symlinks and non-files before canonical containment; a basename child regular file resolves inside canonicalArtifactRoot, so this defensive canonical escape rejection cannot execute.
